with.run:
set -euo pipefail
python --version
if [ -n "${AGENT_ARCHIVE_BASE:-}" ]; then
  git rev-parse --verify --end-of-options "${AGENT_ARCHIVE_BASE}^{commit}" >/dev/null
elif [ "${CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME:-}" != "dev" ]; then
  git fetch --no-tags origin refs/heads/dev
  AGENT_ARCHIVE_BASE="$(git merge-base HEAD FETCH_HEAD)"
elif git rev-parse --verify HEAD^ >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  AGENT_ARCHIVE_BASE="$(git rev-parse HEAD^)"
else
  AGENT_ARCHIVE_BASE="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
fi
export AGENT_ARCHIVE_BASE
printf 'Archive comparison baseline: %s\n' "$AGENT_ARCHIVE_BASE"
python scripts/check.py

setup_node.name: 安装并校验 Node 24.22.1（缓存官方归档）

with.run:
set -euo pipefail
node_version=24.22.1
node_sha256=6c172a9ab6718f7b801fb5a7bd486af2ee5e32758086a04b84fcce2aa77095e6
node_cache="$HOME/.cache/ptmcp/node"
mkdir -p "$node_cache"
node_archive="$node_cache/node-v${node_version}-linux-x64.tar.xz"
if ! printf '%s  %s\n' "$node_sha256" "$node_archive" | sha256sum --check --status; then
  wget --https-only --timeout=30 --tries=3 -q \
    "https://nodejs.org/dist/v${node_version}/node-v${node_version}-linux-x64.tar.xz" \
    -O "${node_archive}.part"
  printf '%s  %s\n' "$node_sha256" "${node_archive}.part" | sha256sum --check
  mv -- "${node_archive}.part" "$node_archive"
fi
tar -xJf "$node_archive" -C /opt
